findings.evidence: Dashboard audit-trail table renders the raw NF525 action code as a styled visible badge 4 times: DOM contains `order.created.pos` (x4, not display:none/hidden ancestor). The string 'order.created.pos' matches the i18n-leak regex ^[a-z]+(\.[a-z_]+){1,4}$. Sibling rows translate correctly ('Connexion utilisateur', 'Mouvement de caisse enregistré') so this row stands out as untranslated. Console (01-dashboard.console.json + 07-eod-button-observe.console.json) corroborates: 8x + 4x `[intlify] Not found 'label.audit_event_order_created_pos' key in 'fr' locale messages.` (level=warning). Root cause: AuditTrailComponent.vue:77-82 translateAction() builds key 'label.audit_event_' + action.replace(/./g,'_') = 'label.audit_event_order_created_pos'; on miss it returns the RAW action ('order.created.pos'), which leaks. Verified key ABSENT in BOTH locales: grep 'audit_event_order_created' resources/js/languages/fr.json and en.json = 0 hits (siblings audit_event_order_counter_payment_confirmed / audit_event_order_refund_counter_entry exist at fr.json L916-917 / en.json L755-756).
findings.fix_hint: Add the missing key (and any sibling order-lifecycle audit codes) in resources/js/languages/fr.json (~L915, after audit_event_z_report_opened) e.g. "audit_event_order_created_pos": "Commande créée (caisse)", and the EN mirror in resources/js/languages/en.json (~L757). Audit all distinct DB action codes emitted by AuditLogService against the audit_event_* key set so no other lifecycle code (order.created.kiosk, order.status.changed, etc.) leaks. Do NOT alter the canonical DB action string (NF525 HMAC chain) — rendering-layer translation only.

findings.evidence: On /admin/cash-overview (date filter = today 06/02/2026): the summary cards read 'Grand total 0,00\u00a0\u20ac 0 tx' (Caisse/Borne/Livreur all 0,00\u20ac/0tx) and the empty placeholder 'Aucune transaction trouvee pour les filtres actuels' is shown, WHILE the reconciliation block reads 'Especes encaissees aujourd'hui: 52,00\u00a0\u20ac' and 'Especes attendues au tiroir: 102,00\u00a0\u20ac' (Fond de caisse 50,00\u20ac, caisse ouverte a 18:27). Independently VERIFIED these are TWO DIFFERENT data sources, neither incorrect: CashOverviewController.php:116 builds the summary from `transactions WHERE type='payment'` inside the requested date window (=0 today), whereas the reconciliation card (CashOverviewController.php:218-245) derives from the live OPEN CashDrawerSession (opening_amount 50,00 + positive cash movements => 52,00 encaisse / 102,00 attendu), and that block is intentionally NOT clamped to the transactions date window. Category-11 P0 requires the SAME fact to differ across surfaces; here the two numbers are different facts (date-filtered transaction encashments vs live open-drawer cash). Hence P2 UX-confusion (admin sees '0 tx / aucune transaction' next to 'encaisse 52,00\u20ac' on one screen), NOT a P0 numeric-integrity break, NOT a fiscal/GATE-ESCALATION. NOTE: did NOT verify what wrote the 52,00\u20ac of drawer movements; classification does not depend on it.
findings.fix_hint: CashOverviewComponent.vue: add a one-line caption distinguishing the two metrics (e.g. summary = 'Transactions encaissees (periode filtree)' vs reconciliation = 'Tiroir ouvert en cours, hors filtre date') so an admin does not read 0 tx / aucune transaction as contradicting 52,00\u20ac encaisse. No backend/fiscal change.
